meta.title: Kingy Local AI Scoreboard
meta.cite: Kingy AI, Kingy Local AI Scoreboard, https://kingy.ai/local-ai-scoreboard/
meta.score_rule: Score is the average of the nine job scores. A job score is the share of that job's hidden checks passed, averaged over three runs.

tie_rule.text: Two models are tied when their scores are closer than twice the pooled standard deviation of a model's three full-pass scores on the Lucy AI Studio.

meta.older_job_set: job-set-0.2/ holds the job set 0.2 files exactly as published on Nov 16-24, 2026. Scores from the two job sets cannot be compared.
meta.disclosure: Cephalon sent us the Lucy AI Studio for free and paid for an earlier video on the Kingy AI YouTube channel. They did not pay for this scoreboard, do not see results before they are published, and have no say in them. Kingy AI bought the Mac and the laptop. Kingy AI also rents the RTX 4070 Ti, RTX 5080, RTX 4090 and RTX 5090 by the hour from RunPod and pays for them itself. Claude, an AI made by Anthropic, runs the tests. Scores come from fixed code checks, and Curtis Pyke picks the best creative results without knowing which model made them.

jobs.what_the_model_does: A one-page website for a made-up coffee club, built from the owner’s notes and three supplied pictures, with a working sign-up form.
A browser app for expenses: add, edit and delete, categories, a filter and budgets, undo and redo over several steps, and export and import of a CSV file with awkward rows.
A small arcade game with levels, golden beans, pause and game over. A bot plays it.
Fix a small Python project so it does exactly what its README says. One test fails at the start, and the whole file has to match the README.

A Python script that cleans a messy sales file (mixed date styles, refunds, repeats, edited sales), converts other currencies to US dollars, totals and finds the median for each month and draws a bar chart.
15 questions about a long made-up annual report from a ferry company. Some need facts combined or simple sums. If the report does not give an answer, the model must say so.

With file tools only and at most 30 tool calls, answer questions from a bike shop’s work files (including a figure corrected by a later memo and one question the files cannot answer) and name the source files.
A 10-second 4K title card for a show, drawn frame by frame in code, with a centred title and a countdown.
A Python script that cuts a 2-minute 4K talk down to a 30-second highlight with ffmpeg, keeping set sentences and never cutting mid-sentence.
